editorial.copyrightPolicy: Publisher article text and league copy are never copied; Swoon'd explains developments in its own words with links to the original publisher. Rulebook text is paraphrased with rule references.

masteryModel.usefulCompetenceStatement: She can follow a baseball game or a broadcast, read the scoreboard and the box score, understand the count and the modern rules, ask a couple of good questions about a bullpen or a lineup, and say 'okay, I get why you love this' without faking it.

licensingConstraints.constraint: Procedural or original illustrations only (license original-swoond); no MLB, team, player or ballpark photos and no baseball-card images.
Original recordings or synthesised sounds only (license original-swoond); no broadcast audio and no licensed songs or recorded arrangements.
MLB, team, NCAA, NPB, KBO, World Series, Statcast and Gold Glove marks are trademarks: plain-text mentions and link-outs only, no logos or wordmarks; non-affiliation footer.
No embedded broadcast or highlight video; deep-link to official sources.
Never copy publisher or league article text; paraphrase and link.

The MLB Stats API and Baseball Savant are not used in production without a licence; FanGraphs and Baseball-Reference are link-out only; Retrosheet needs its notice; the Lahman database is CC BY-SA 3.0 (share-alike, legal check); NCAA statistics and D1Baseball rankings are link-out only.
Names as facts only; no likeness, endorsement implication, or fabricated quotes; historical figures discussed factually and respectfully.
No betting or gambling content; labour-dispute and PED-era topics are neutral, factual and dated.

safetyConstraints: Youth baseball notes (pitch counts, rest days) are league safety rules, not medical advice; injury topics such as Tommy John surgery are explained as context and never as predictions about named players.
Etiquette and umpire or fan conflict scenarios teach de-escalation; never coach confrontation, and heckling lessons teach good-natured cheering only.
Ballpark tips include foul-ball awareness (watch the ball, keep children away from the dugout side); Swoon'd is not a substitute for any coaching or safety training.
Never encourage the learner to fake knowledge or expertise with the person they care about.
